description: Hi, I’m Hrishi, a first-year Aerospace Engineering student at Nottingham (Python, C++). We’re building Polar Window: an interactive tool comparing lunar south pole landing sites and dates by Sun and Earth visibility, using real JPL Horizons data, with a best-start-date scanner and a plain-English mode. Looking for help with LOLA terrain horizons, a planetary science or mission-ops sanity check, and design/comms for the pitch. Any experience level welcome. Message me!
